behavior_case.title: Reserve credit establishes payment evidence before shipment eligibility
behavior_case.summary: Domain-only behavior case. DDD/fDDD context maps, surfaces, code refs, coverage policy, and codegen live in the tooling overlay.

notes: These are domain facts, not implementation-surface claims.

when.label: Ask whether the accepted order can be treated as shipment-eligible after credit reservation

expected_outcomes: The reservation supports an accepted payment fact for the order.
The accepted payment authorizes the shipment.
The order is eligible for shipment in the accepted world.

competency_questions.name: reservation_normalizes_to_payment
competency_questions.question: Can the accepted reservation justify the payment fact used by checkout?
competency_questions.query: select ?f where ?f = OrderFulfillment.OrderHasPayment(order=Order_1001, payment=Payment_9001, ctx=Accepted, time=T1) limit 1

competency_questions.name: accepted_order_is_shipment_eligible
competency_questions.question: Can an accepted paid order become shipment-eligible?
competency_questions.query: select ?f where ?f = OrderFulfillment.OrderEligibleForShipment(order=Order_1001, shipment=Shipment_7001, ctx=Accepted, time=T1) limit 1

notes: Strong behavior-case use still depends on overlay coverage and theory-check status.
This payload intentionally has no context, implementation_surfaces, or coverage_edges fields.
